question: In which state is the first Graphene Innovation Centre of the India set up?
solution:
The correct answer is__** **____**Kerala**____**.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India’s first Graphene Innovation Centre set up in Kerala.**
 
• **Graphene** is a form of **carbon** that has unique properties such as high** thermal and electrical** conductivity, **mechanical strength**, and** flexibility.**
 
• It is considered a wonder material with potential applications in various fields such as **electronics, energy, and medicine.**
 
• India is one of the leading countries in graphene research and has several** research institutions and startups** working on graphene-related projects.
 
• The centre is a collaboration between the Telangana government and the **Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Hyderabad.**
 
• It aims to promote research and development of **graphene-based technologies** and products.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kerala, Gujarat, and Karnataka **are among the states in India that have active research and development activities in graphene.
 
• Kerala has a Graphene Research Centre at the **Cochin University of Science and Technology.**
 
• Gujarat has a Graphene Centre at the **Gujarat Council on Science and Technology.**
 
• Karnataka has several institutions and startups working on graphene research, including the** Indian Institute of Science (IISc**) and the **startup Log 9 Materials.**
